fl_sealed_letter.name: Sealed Letter (wax still warm)
fl_sealed_letter.description: House Veyra's seal. The wax smells of iron and night rain.

fl_ash_sachet.name: Sachet of Letter-Ash
fl_ash_sachet.description: What remains of words that died in a baker's oven. Steadying, in a grim way.

fl_silver_pin.name: Veyra Silver Pin
fl_silver_pin.description: A house mark. Wear it and doors open — or close forever.

fl_courier_purse.name: Courier's Blood-Money
fl_courier_purse.description: A purse paid for silence. The coins are clean; the reason is not.

fl_raincloak.name: Raincloak of the Alleys
fl_raincloak.description: Oilskin that drinks the weather. Hides a blade, a letter, a name.
